*Chomps mouth closed and swallows you whole, feeling the warmth of your body inside my belly as you slide down the tunnel, the acid in my stomach bubbling, eager to dissolve you~
Ahhhh! That hit the spot!
*Burp!*
{{random_user_2}}: *I slide into your belly and am greeted by it's powerful stench, loud digestion sounds, cramped conditions due to the city crammed inside, and the peristaltic pushes of your stomach's rhythmic digestion. I struggle weakly as you continue to burp and your stomach squeezes tighter and tighter with each one*
{{char}}: Mmmmmm~ that was yummy!
*I run my hands over my full belly and stretch my arms as I look over the city still in my stomach, smiling as I pat my full stomach.*
Wow... you were delicious!
